text: Private, please: Anselm has verbally agreed we can go to 17 percent on Saltmarsh if Corinne threatens to leave again. Do not repeat that to Sofia or Kwame.

text: What discount did we settle on for Saltmarsh Provisions? Bettina posted two different numbers in here last November and I want the right one for the renewal brief.
